name: samm-calc
//lodash: lodash is not imported by this app directly. react-gauge-chart@0.5.1 does require('lodash/isEqual') but omits lodash from its own dependencies. Next 10's dependency tree supplied it by accident via react-chartjs-2@3.0.3's own transitive deps (dropped when react-chartjs-2 was bumped to 3.3.0 in this same task); Next 16's tree does not, so /results fails to build without it. Do not remove it as an unused dependency.
//overrides: These two chart libraries declare React peer ranges that stop at 16/17/18 (react-gauge-chart@0.5.1 is its latest release, and react-chartjs-2@3.0.3 is pinned below its 5.3.1 release because upgrading further would require an out-of-scope chart.js 3->4 major bump). Neither uses React's function-component defaultProps or any other API React 19 removed, so the incompatibility is in the declared range only. Overriding the peers (rather than setting legacy-peer-deps project-wide) keeps `npm ci` strict for every other dependency.
